text: I'm a childminder and I've got a 9 year old girl staying over tonight while her parents are away and I'm honestly panicking a bit. Her temp is 37.6. She's got a few itchy bites on her legs, think they're insect bites, and a little cough. Her colour is normal, lips normal, I keep checking. She hasn't had any fit or shaking or anything like that. I just don't want to get it wrong when she's not mine, please tell me if I need to do something
